name: WOW Porto: The Chocolate Story
description: A guaranteed hit with children, this museum in the WOW cultural district explores the world of cacao and chocolate.
longDescription:
WOW Porto: The Chocolate Story is an immersive museum experience dedicated to the journey of cacao from bean to bar. Located within the WOW cultural district in Vila Nova de Gaia, this permanent exhibition delves into the history, cultivation, and production processes of chocolate, offering insights into its global impact and cultural significance. It aims to educate visitors on the complexities and artistry involved in creating this beloved confection.

Visitors can expect an engaging and informative journey through various themed zones, designed to appeal to a broad audience, particularly families. The exhibition provides a multi-sensory exploration of chocolate, from its origins in ancient civilisations to modern-day manufacturing techniques. The experience is self-guided, allowing guests to explore at their own pace within the contemporary setting of the WOW complex.

Admission to WOW Porto: The Chocolate Story is ticketed. The WOW cultural district is situated in Vila Nova de Gaia, easily accessible from Porto via the D. Luís I Bridge. Public transport options include bus services to Vila Nova de Gaia, and it is a walkable distance from the Jardim do Morro metro station on the Yellow Line (D). The venue is designed to be family-friendly.
